repository.name: lighthouse
repository.description: Reusable engineering baseline with package-owned guidance, profiles and deterministic checks.

output.content:
added 415 packages, and audited 419 packages in 2m

63 packages are looking for funding
  run `npm fund` for details

3 low severity vulnerabilities

Some issues need review, and may require choosing
a different dependency.

Run `npm audit` for details.

✔ legacy init JSON previews project the local plan and preserve target bytes, modes and Git configuration (1358.375365ms)
✔ legacy init JSON and text conflicts preserve files and exit one (373.274374ms)
✔ legacy init rejects every JSON apply mode before writes (979.74845ms)
✔ init creates a projection and refuses to overwrite product work (395.980102ms)
✔ required repository boundaries survive committing and cloning a fresh initialization (682.698568ms)
✔ verify reports projection drift and invalid manifests (366.645487ms)
✔ manifest cannot advertise unsupported checks or unverified managed files (608.322239ms)
✔ greenfield init creates the repository boundaries and a default manifest (185.090515ms)
✔ aliases reports the harness and SDLC command contracts without duplicating implementations (62.387235ms)
✔ semantic init previews without a reference and applies only after explicit authorization (270.263424ms)
✔ semantic init stops on unresolved questions before writing (176.217817ms)
✔ semantic init does not require a declared reference to exist (90.019369ms)

✔ profiles exposes applicability and verification layers without making them all mandatory (444.638007ms)

✔ react web profile projects its guidance and requires the visual contract (198.527468ms)
✔ web BFF profile projects its security contract and requires the private web composition (193.460166ms)
✔ PWA capability projects its offline contract as an optional React extension (180.064475ms)
✔ Expo mobile profile projects native guidance without selecting the React web profile (185.795949ms)
✔ MAUI mobile profile projects native guidance and rejects the Expo combination (258.227066ms)

✔ visual-theme validation requires its pinned UI package (153.067925ms)
✔ init dry-run reports brownfield conflicts without writing (117.63941ms)
✔ reconcile previews and applies missing managed paths without overwriting drift (303.293247ms)
✔ upgrade previews and applies a missing owned projection (335.081115ms)
✔ foundation initialization and upgrade preserve optional workflow ownership (191.674065ms)
✔ upgrade projects the alias map as an SDLC-owned projection (225.406238ms)
✔ upgrade discovers pending SDLC capability adoption without writing remote or reconciliation state (372.646672ms)
✔ a new label capability version requests adoption review without resetting other capabilities (173.5503ms)
✔ capability adoption requires the plan hash, creates only missing labels and is idempotent (2491.692215ms)
✔ capability selection and decline are explicit local decisions (523.412851ms)
✔ upgrade preserves customized projections and reports missing ownership evidence (385.610376ms)
✔ upgrade stops a baseline mismatch for human review (265.329541ms)
✔ verify keeps the human output and exposes the existing catalog as JSON (268.379883ms)
✔ verify JSON distinguishes managed projection drift (165.35956ms)
✔ verify validates evidence indexes and reports drift without blocking delivery (329.841331ms)
✔ catalog keeps level and kind independent and records pending human review (1.077977ms)
✔ generated guidance follows adopted authorities and scopes the documentation-site gate (536.999592ms)
